SELECT
    RAWTOHEX(A.APPROVAL_ACTIVITY_ID) AS ACTIVITY_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(A.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_ID,
    A.CYCLE_NO,
    Q.QUEUE_CODE,
    Q.QUEUE_NAME,
    A.ACTIVITY_STATUS,
    R.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
    R.REQUEST_TYPE_ID,
    TP.REQUEST_TYPE_NAME,
    ST.STATUS_CODE AS REQUEST_STATUS,
    R.REQUEST_DATE,
    RAWTOHEX(M.MERCHANT_ID) AS MERCHANT_ID,
    M.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
    M.CIF,
    M.BRANCH_CODE,
    RM.RM_NAME
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_APPROVAL_ACTIVITY A
JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_APPROVAL_QUEUE Q
  ON Q.QUEUE_ID = A.QUEUE_ID
 AND Q.ACTIVE_FLAG = 1
JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST R
  ON R.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID
 AND NVL(R.IS_DELETED,0) = 0
JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT M
  ON M.MERCHANT_ID = R.MERCHANT_ID
 AND NVL(M.IS_DELETED,0) = 0
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS RM
  ON RM.RM_ID = R.RM_ID
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_TYPE TP
  ON TP.REQUEST_TYPE_ID = R.REQUEST_TYPE_ID
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_STATUS ST
  ON ST.STATUS_ID = R.STATUS_ID
WHERE A.ACTIVITY_STATUS = 'PENDING'
  AND ST.STATUS_CODE = 'ST-SUBMITTED'
ORDER BY A.CREATED_AT DESC
